product_name: Creating a social media strategy for your education brand

product_name: AI Playbook for School Marketing, Admissions and Commercial

target_buyer: Education marketing and communications professionals

price_ex_vat: £1,996 + VAT per course for up to 2 team members

what_is_included: Six video modules, workbook per module, pre-populated or mapped marketing plan, weekly live check-in, CPD certificate. Modules cover messaging, website and social, trust-building, digital and offline promotion, and conversion events.
tangible_outputs: Marketing plan and completed workbook tasks.
assessment_or_certificate: Certificate of completion described as recognised CPD
coaching_included: Weekly live check-in for questions. Not described as a private coaching series.
done_for_you_element: The plan is pre-populated. Execution stays with the school.
free_trial_or_free_entry: Free health check is a separate lead product.
next_obvious_paid_step: Strategic marketing plan over three months.
upsell_or_cross_sell: Admissions course; strategic marketing plan; consultancy
evidence_notes: Only published price found. The page is titled January sale and does not show a higher crossed-out list price. The main course page does not state a fee. Currency of the sale title versus a standing price is unresolved.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Three-month strategic marketing plan or done-with-you consultancy.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: £1,996 + VAT for two people, with videos plus a weekly live check-in and a finished plan, is the clearest school-marketing programme price in this batch. A second person is included, which changes per-head comparisons.

target_buyer: Admissions and marketing staff. Up to two people per booking.
problem_solved: Enquiry handling, visits and events do not convert.
format: Six modules with videos, tools and a weekly live check-in
price_ex_vat: £1,996 + VAT per course for up to 2 team members
what_is_included: Six modules from first enquiry through visit, events and acceptance, plus workbooks, tools and a completion certificate.
tangible_outputs: Mapped activities and workbook tasks.
next_obvious_paid_step: Strategic marketing plan or in-school support.
evidence_notes: Same price block covers both courses. Sale-page caveat as for the marketing course.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Buy the companion course or the three-month plan.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Admissions conversion is split from marketing as its own SKU at the same price. The commercial job is a second purchase, not a longer single course.

target_buyer: School leaders and marketing leads
problem_solved: Need a bespoke plan rather than a standard course.
what_is_included: Online and in-person consultation and independent auditing to co-create a strategic marketing plan. Session count NOT PUBLISHED.
tangible_outputs: Bespoke strategic marketing plan.
report_description: Strategic marketing plan. Contents beyond the name are NOT PUBLISHED.
implementation_support: Co-created over three months. Done-for-you execution NOT PUBLISHED.
free_trial_or_free_entry: Free health check can precede it.
next_obvious_paid_step: Ongoing support. Scope NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Duration and output are published. Price is not.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Retained support or the online courses for the wider team.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The three-month plan is the premium sibling of a £2k course, and its price is hidden. That is the band a commercial-growth diagnostic has to sit in or explain.

product_name: Free marketing and admissions health check
target_buyer: School leaders and marketers
problem_solved: No quick view of strengths and weaknesses before buying help.
what_is_included: Scores, hints, tips and suggestions. Described as a mini audit.
tangible_outputs: Personalised scores and suggestions.
report_included: Scores and suggestions. A long-form report is NOT PUBLISHED.
free_trial_or_free_entry: Yes, this is the free entry.
next_obvious_paid_step: Online course or strategic marketing plan, via a 20-minute call.
evidence_notes: Free diagnostic is explicit. Depth of the output is not shown without completing it.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Booked call into a course or the three-month plan.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A two-minute scored health check is the public version of a commercial-growth scorecard. It is free and automated, then a human call sells the plan.

target_buyer: Staff new to school marketing, communications or income generation
target_sector: Schools and MATs, including primary, secondary and special schools
problem_solved: No foundation course the office can finish around the day job.
duration: 12 months access. About 4 hours of self-study stated on the course page.
price_inc_vat_if_relevant: £180 on the Education Conferences UK checkout
what_is_included: Six modules, parallel workbook, editable templates, quizzes. Booking is via Education Conferences UK.
tangible_outputs: Completed workbook and templates. Certificate after passing.
next_obvious_paid_step: Live Marketing Your School masterclass or in-school day.
evidence_notes: Provider page states £150 + VAT. Checkout at https://www.educationconferencesuk.co.uk/elearning/marketing-essentials-for-schools shows £150.00 and £180.00 including VAT, and calls £150 a launch offer against £225 + VAT. Whether the higher price is still the list price is not clear.
analysis_likely_strategic_purpose: scalable IP; low-risk entry; lead gen
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: In-school masterclass or bid-writing day.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Four hours of asynchronous school marketing is £150 + VAT. A £295 live workshop has to be obviously more useful than this commoditised rung.

target_buyer: School business leaders, heads, office teams, MAT staff, governors
problem_solved: The person handed marketing has no practical system for story, website, admissions and communications.
format: Public day, in-school day, half day, or live online
group_price: In-school delivery quoted. ISBL members save 15%.
what_is_included: Work on the school's own situation. Resource pack, marketing plan template, communications calendar, audit checklists, and a year of FundEd. Attendance confirmation for CPD. ISBL Professional Standards alignment is a provider claim.
tangible_outputs: Shortlists, plans, drafts, templates and an action plan.
report_included: No formal report. Action plan yes.
coaching_included: Many schools book a term-later follow-up call. It is optional and not included as a counted session.
implementation_support: Action plan only, unless follow-up or consultancy is bought.
next_obvious_paid_step: Term-later call or ongoing consultancy.
evidence_notes: Price is contact-only. Inclusions and the ISBL discount are published.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Consultancy after the day.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The live marketing day is the direct analogue of a £295-£595 workshop, but the public price is withheld. Templates plus a third-party subscription (FundEd) are used as included value.

target_buyer: School staff who will write funding applications
problem_solved: Applications are weak or staff do not know what funders look for.
price_ex_vat: £250. VAT status NOT PUBLISHED on the source that states the fee.
what_is_included: Practical session, funder insight, two portal walk-throughs, templates and resources, free grant-finder access.
tangible_outputs: Templates and grant-finder access.
software_or_platform_access: Grant-finder access. Duration of that access NOT PUBLISHED.
done_for_you_element: No. Done-for-you bid writing is a separate service with unpublished fees.
next_obvious_paid_step: Winning Bids full day or done-for-you bid writing.
evidence_notes: Course page lists inclusions but not the fee. Provider blog https://m.chameleon-training.co.uk/resources/blog/school-success-with-chameleons-online-courses states both online courses are priced at £250. VAT not stated there. A 24 September date is on the course page without a year.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: In-school Winning Bids day or paid bid writing.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A half-day income-generation masterclass can be sold at £250 if the full day and the done-for-you service sit behind it.

target_buyer: Individual schools, small MATs, regional school-business groups
problem_solved: The team needs a longer, private bid-writing session rather than a half-day open course.
format: In-school day or three live online modules
duration: 1 day in school, or 3 online modules
price_ex_vat: In-school individual school or small MAT £950 + VAT. Regional group or MAT £1,250 + VAT. Online three modules £950 + VAT.
group_price: In-school small team minimum 2 and maximum 5 at £950 + VAT. Regional or MAT minimum 5 and maximum 25 at £1,250 + VAT. Online minimum 2 and maximum 25 at £950 + VAT. Venue and refreshments provided by the school for in-person.
what_is_included: Face-to-face day or three live webinars. Detailed agenda NOT PUBLISHED on the price block.
tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED
toolkit_or_templates: Training pages say practical templates in the bid-writing range. This page's inclusion list is thin.
next_obvious_paid_step: Done-for-you bid writing. Fees agreed per project and NOT PUBLISHED.
evidence_notes: Two delivery modes and two in-person group bands are published. They are tiers of one masterclass, so they share a row.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Justin writes the bid.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A private education team day is £950 + VAT for up to five people, and £1,250 + VAT for up to 25. Per-head value collapses as the group grows, which is how a small specialist can still sell a day.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Providers and employers with government-funded learners or levy interest
target_sector: ITPs; colleges; employer providers; local authorities; HEIs
problem_solved: Need for policy intelligence, a model contract and a sector network.
membership_price: By contracted learners: up to 100 £730; 101-250 £850; 251-500 £1,320; 501-1000 £2,400; 1001-2500 £3,710; 2501-4999 £6,190; 5000+ £12,520. Levy employer over £500k £1,550; under £500k £780; non-levy employer £730. VAT status NOT PUBLISHED.
minimum_term: Annual rate. Pro-rata for part year NOT PUBLISHED.
what_is_included: Lobbying, policy updates, practical business support, access to the Apprenticeship Levy Model Contract, events, forums and sector interest groups.
tangible_outputs: Apprenticeship Levy Model Contract. Other templates NOT PUBLISHED.
next_obvious_paid_step: Paid conferences and workshops at member rates.
upsell_or_cross_sell: National conference, autumn conference and themed summits
evidence_notes: Bands are published. VAT is not mentioned.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Member-priced events and paid workshops.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The trade body is the default network. A specialist commercial offer has to sit beside membership, not replace policy updates.

target_buyer: Independent schools
problem_solved: Admissions and marketing staff need a sector network and discounted training.
duration: Annual, invoices in September. Mid-year joiners are pro rata.
membership_price: Prep school £136. Senior school £272. VAT status NOT PUBLISHED. One subscription covers the whole school.
what_is_included: Event and training discounts for everyone at the member school. A full benefit list beyond access and discount is not itemised on the fee page.
tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED
next_obvious_paid_step: Diploma or a CPD workshop at the member rate.
evidence_notes: Fees renew automatically.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Diploma, which the association describes as the sector qualification.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: School-wide membership at £136 or £272 makes the training discount the product. Open workshop prices then do the selling.

target_buyer: People already working in independent-school marketing
problem_solved: No sector-specific qualification for school marketers.
format: Two-day workshop plus assignments using the school's own data
expert_live_hours_if_published: About 14 contact hours across two days. Breaks not stated, so exact taught hours are NOT PUBLISHED.
cohort_length: 14-15 October 2026 for the taught days. Assignment window NOT PUBLISHED.
what_is_included: Taught diploma with assignments that use the candidate's school. CPD Standards Office accreditation is claimed. Formal CPD certificate. Trainers named from RSAcademics.
tangible_outputs: Assignments based on the school's marketing data. A template pack is NOT PUBLISHED.
assessment_or_certificate: Formal CPD certificate. It is described as a diploma. Regulated qualification status is NOT PUBLISHED.
next_obvious_paid_step: Further CPD workshops or consultancy from the named trainers' firms.
evidence_notes: Bookings were open on the page. Price was not on the page. A separate Admissions Diploma is listed on the calendar and is not given its own row because its price, days and inclusions were not extracted.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: The trainers' own consultancies, including RSAcademics and, on Attenger's account, Attenger.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The premium school-marketing qualification hides its price. Status and a certificate are the product, not a published toolkit.

target_buyer: Independent-school marketing and admissions staff
problem_solved: Short practical gaps in brand, copy, digital, research or stakeholder communications.
price_ex_vat: Member £185. Non-member £285. VAT status NOT PUBLISHED.
what_is_included: Named workshops on the booking page: implementing a marketing brand, impactful copywriting, digital marketing, marketing strategy research, stakeholder communications.
tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED
assessment_or_certificate: AMCIS states training activities are CPD accredited and that formal CPD certificates are issued. This page does not repeat that for each workshop.
next_obvious_paid_step: Diploma, if not already held.
evidence_notes: The dates printed beside those prices run from January to June 2026 and had passed by 2 October 2026. Treat the figures as the last published tariff, not as proof a future date is on sale at the same fee.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Diploma or membership.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A one-workshop member price of £185 and a non-member price of £285 is the commodity band for independent-school marketing CPD.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Finance, compliance, employer-facing and commercial leads in funded providers
target_sector: Government-funded training providers, including employer providers
problem_solved: Providers cannot tell if a standard is viable, compliantly priced and forecastable.

duration: Three sessions of two hours: 4, 8 and 10 December. Year on the page is the 26/27 update. Start date printed as 4 December.
learner_total_hours_if_published: 6 live hours. Extra practice NOT PUBLISHED.
what_is_included: Live webinars or recordings, slide decks, Q&A, attendance certificate, apprenticeship costs and budgeting tool, revenue forecasting tool, recognition of prior learning calculator using 2025-26 funding rules.
tangible_outputs: Three tools: costing and budgeting, revenue forecast, RPL calculator.
next_obvious_paid_step: Same series plus a one-hour consultancy call at £350 + VAT.
evidence_notes: Group booking discount is offered by email and not priced. Public-sector invoice route exists.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: The £350 tier, then a compliance retainer.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Six live hours, recordings, slides and three tools are £245 + VAT. Adding one consultancy hour lifts the price to £350 + VAT. That is a published workshop-plus-clinic ladder in the ITP market.

product_name: Apprenticeship financial management plus consultancy call
product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Same as the webinar series, wanting one applied conversation
problem_solved: The tools still need applying to the provider's own numbers.

what_is_included: Everything in the £245 series plus a one-hour consultancy call.
tangible_outputs: The three tools, plus advice on the provider's own case.
next_obvious_paid_step: Retained compliance support.
evidence_notes: Explicit second price on the same page.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Compliance design retainer.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The clinic is a £105 + VAT add-on for one hour, not a new product family. Four Corners' £395 and £595 steps need a similarly visible extra.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Leaders, new staff and data teams in apprenticeship providers
target_sector: ITPs, colleges, universities and employer providers
problem_solved: Compliance knowledge sits with one person rather than the whole delivery system.
duration: Each topic is at least three sessions of two hours
what_is_included: Named packages: compliance for leaders, fundamentals for a role, data management including the ILR, and the financial series which is priced separately. CPD attendance certificate. A leaders' series is described as CPD accredited.
tangible_outputs: Certificate. Templates are a separate toolkit list.
next_obvious_paid_step: Compliance design, mock audit or retainer.
evidence_notes: Hours are published. Prices for these packages, other than the financial series, are not.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Mock audit or retainer.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Compliance training is sold in six-hour blocks and then into audit support. The price of the block is hidden, unlike the financial series.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Provider leaders responsible for funding assurance
problem_solved: Evidence packs, subcontracting, learning-support claims or an upcoming audit are not safe.
format: Project or retainer. Pre-audit, during-audit and post-audit packages.
what_is_included: Menu includes programme design, evidence-pack templates, subcontractor compliance, learning-support claims, mock audit, live audit support and post-audit implementation.
tangible_outputs: Evidence-pack templates and contract documentation are named. A standard report is NOT PUBLISHED.
toolkit_or_templates: RPL calculator, costing tool, initial assessment, training plan, enrolment, change of circumstance, withdrawal, progress review, gateway review, part-completion record.
done_for_you_element: Partial. Design and templates can be done for the provider. Scope is quoted.
next_obvious_paid_step: Retainer after a project.
evidence_notes: No fees. Page dated in the extract as 14 November 2025.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Annual retainer and Mesma licences.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The defensible ITP offer is audit-grade templates plus a human who will sit with the provider through an audit. Training is the shop window.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Quality leads in FE, skills and employability providers
target_sector: Colleges, training providers, universities and employability organisations
problem_solved: Quality assurance is scattered across documents rather than a shared system.
membership_price: Essentials £27 per week for 2 users for 12 months. Then £2,250 a year excluding VAT up to 10 users; £3,525 a year excluding VAT up to 40 users; from £6,175 a year excluding VAT up to 100 users; from £8,000 a year excluding VAT for multi-organisation use. VAT on the £27 weekly price is NOT PUBLISHED.
minimum_term: Essentials is described as 12 months for two users. Other plans are per annum. Cancellation terms are in the licence, not repeated here.
what_is_included: Evaluate and improve tools. Plans page also lists specialist support, exclusive resources, special consultancy rates and 10% off professional development.
tangible_outputs: Quality records inside the platform.
implementation_support: Support offers are mentioned. Hours NOT PUBLISHED.
next_obvious_paid_step: Consultancy at the subscriber rate, or a larger user band.
evidence_notes: Essentials weekly price is on https://mesma.co.uk/mesma-essentials/. Licence says fees are exclusive of VAT. Two-product and three-product 15% offers are mentioned without the second and third product names in the extract.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Consultancy and the training catalogue at 10% off.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Software turns a compliance trainer into a subscription. A small specialist without a platform has to win on diagnosis and implementation instead.

product_category: B Commercial growth and employer engagement
target_buyer: Business development teams in colleges and training providers

next_obvious_paid_step: Outsourced or interim business development.

analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The closest named competitor for college and ITP commercial training does not publish a price, a day length or a leave-behind. The offer is bespoke facilitation into an outsourcing relationship.

product_category: B Commercial growth and employer engagement
target_buyer: Cross-college managers, delivery leaders and support teams

tangible_outputs: The integrated programme aims at an operational plan. A standard template is NOT PUBLISHED.
implementation_support: Customisation included in the unpublished price.
next_obvious_paid_step: Sales programmes or outsourced business development.
evidence_notes: Session outline for the integrated programme is on a child page. Still no price or hours.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: A second team in the same college buys the sales programme.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Employer-account growth is framed as a whole-organisation workshop, not a marketing course. That matches a commercial-growth programme better than a social-media SKU.

target_buyer: Teachers, trainers, assessors and support staff in FE and skills
problem_solved: Practitioners need a professional grade, CPD access and, for QTLS, active membership.
duration: Membership year 1 April to 31 March. Fees pro-rated by join date.
membership_price: Several grades £93 a year by direct debit or £99.50 by card. Advanced grade £105 by direct debit or £115 by card. VAT status NOT PUBLISHED.
what_is_included: Member CPD events, on-demand resources, eBook library, inTuition, and 10% off many CPD courses. QTLS requires active membership but is a separate fee.
tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED
software_or_platform_access: Member profile and, for QTLS, the professional formation portal
next_obvious_paid_step: A CPD course or QTLS.
evidence_notes: Grade eligibility differs. The fee bands above are the published annual figures. A third-party page citing £97 was not used.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Discounted courses and QTLS.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: Individual FE membership is about £100 a year. It is not the buyer for an organisational growth partnership.

target_buyer: SET members with a recognised teaching qualification
problem_solved: Practitioners want the professional status that can confer QTS when membership stays active.
duration: Often described as running across an academic year. Exact ETF duration NOT PUBLISHED on the FAQ extract.
price_ex_vat: £55 to apply and £570 to participate. VAT status NOT PUBLISHED. Card payment only. Non-refundable outside 14 days.
what_is_included: Application review and moderation. Membership must be held separately.
tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED
assessment_or_certificate: QTLS status if successful. Not a training course certificate.
next_obvious_paid_step: Renew SET membership. Advanced Teacher Status is a later grade, fee not separated here.
evidence_notes: Fees support review of portfolios. This is a status, not a workshop.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Annual membership renewal.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: The sector will pay £570 plus membership for a recognised status. A commercial-growth certificate without regulatory weight will not command that.

product_name: Introducing Leadership in FE and Skills
target_buyer: New and aspiring FE and skills leaders
problem_solved: First-time leaders need a short, practical, networked programme.

tangible_outputs: NOT PUBLISHED

analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Longer leadership programmes and membership.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Organisations applying as a main, supporting or employer provider
target_sector: Independent training providers and employer providers
problem_solved: The register application is too risky to write alone.

tangible_outputs: Completed application and any missing policy templates.
toolkit_or_templates: Policy templates where the client has none
next_obvious_paid_step: Ofsted preparation or monthly quality support after approval.
evidence_notes: Fees are published as set fees with a plus-VAT wording. Gap-in-provision guidance is also offered. Success statistics are marketing claims.

analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A full done-for-you market-entry bid is £3,600 to £4,500 + VAT. A campaign pack or messaging review priced near that has to be narrower or more commercial.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Funded providers facing a monitoring visit or inspection
target_sector: Apprenticeship, adult education budget and adult learner loan providers
problem_solved: Leaders cannot see inspection risk clearly from inside.
format: Two-day quality audit or a curriculum deep dive

tangible_outputs: An action focus is implied. A standard report template is NOT PUBLISHED.

next_obvious_paid_step: Ongoing compliance or data-management support.
evidence_notes: Testimonials describe monthly quality support and a new-provider workshop. Those are not priced products on this page.
analysis_likely_route_to_next_sale: Monthly quality retainer.
analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A two-day external audit is the ITP version of a diagnostic. Its price is withheld, so the market rate for two days of specialist time is still hidden.

product_category: C Apprenticeships FE quality funding compliance Ofsted
target_buyer: Providers considering public funding, bids, accreditation, APAR or EPAO
problem_solved: Leaders want a short expert view before a bid project.

price_ex_vat: 1 hour £120 + VAT. 2 hours £220 + VAT. Shop also lists a consultancy session at £99 + VAT.
what_is_included: Discussion of public funding, bid writing, accreditation, EPAO and the register. Clear next steps are claimed. A written report is NOT PUBLISHED.

analysis_what_four_corners_can_learn: A one-hour specialist session is £120 + VAT and a two-hour session is £220 + VAT. That is far below a £295 workshop and is used only to open a bid.

product_name: How to become a publicly funded training provider

product_category: B Commercial growth and employer engagement
target_buyer: Providers hunting tenders and funding
problem_solved: Teams miss funding rounds and prime-provider opportunities.

tangible_outputs: Tender alerts.
next_obvious_paid_step: Bid-writing retainer.
